lane: A5 clock lane - untested fundamentals mechanisms on the multi-vintage PIT panel, now extended to the death-inclusive cohort (NOT the A4 distress axis: this is a single-ratio balance-sheet shape conditioning, not a hazard/failure-probability composite; NOT the A6 death-event axis: no death-event timing enters any decision)
title: Filed-value equity-stub shape: long book-rich-over-filed-float names, short market-rich-over-book names, sector-neutral on the death-inclusive multi-vintage PIT panel

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: Float-market investors anchoring on the traded float's own price momentum rather than the audited book behind it: when the filed public float is marked far below audited book equity, the marginal float holder is a price-taker on a shrinking float (index outflows, forced sellers) while the book claims are held by parties with liquidation-priority information; the rebalancing crowd that must absorb their exits is slow because none of this ratio is visible in any price screen - it exists only in the filed vintage pair (StockholdersEquity, EntityPublicFloat) that no price/volume monitor tracks.
mechanism.why_the_effect_exists: The ratio S = BookEquity / EntityPublicFloat is a filed-value claim-shape measure: names with S far above 1 are float-marked below audited book (asset-backing support, book claims senior in any terminal distribution), names with S far below 1 are float-marked at multiples of book (franchise premium already capitalized, terminal distributions residual). The effect requires a death-inclusive cohort to measure honestly: a survivor-only panel truncates the terminal branch of the high-S distribution (firms float-marked below book are exactly the ones that die and never re-enter a current-registry sample), so the historical high-S premium is partly a survivorship artifact that this cohort realizes instead of censoring. The conditioning contains zero current-price information by construction: both legs are company-filed vintage values read under PIT as-of clocks, so the mispricing channel is slow re-rating, not fast price reaction.
mechanism.what_observable_measures_it: S(t) = latest-filed-vintage us-gaap:StockholdersEquity divided by latest-filed-vintage dei:EntityPublicFloat, each read as-of decision date t under the funded unbounded clocks cited below (avail < gate(t), never latest-in-store); standardized to a cross-sectional percentile within the frozen sector tag s of the cohort row; tradable rank = HIGH S percentile = long leg (book-rich stub), LOW S percentile = short leg (market-rich stub).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: The effect must fail (i) when the anchor's expectancy <= 0 after band costs - i.e., float-marked-below-book is correctly priced distress on this cohort and the filed-stub channel carries no premium; (ii) when the par-stub placebo control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x |alpha| - i.e., the information is the filed-float denominator / equity-account residue axis (stale filed value vs any equity account), not the going-concern book stub; (iii) when post-drop-one expectancy <= 0 or fewer than 2 of 3 folds are positive; (iv) when the pre-selection control-identifiability gate declared below measures rho > 0.70 - the proposal dies before selection and is never scored.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector filed-stub percentile ranks predict next-quarter relative returns monotonically (high-S leg outperforms low-S leg) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) expectancy > 0 overall, (b) position PF >= 1.1, (c) risk-matched excess vs SPY positive in >= 2 folds and overall alpha > 0, (d) the same vs the mapped sector-ETF factor with ETF positive share <= 0.35, (e) the par-stub placebo control alpha |ratio| < 0.5 of anchor alpha, (f) neighbour (book-cushion depth) same-sign support, and (g) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs every forbidden ancestor rank declared in novelty_declaration, measured before any selection. If any of (a)-(g) fails, the arm is rejected and the filed-stub channel is declared untradable on this death-inclusive cohort at these costs.
literature: Penman, S.H., Richardson, S.A., Tuna, I. (2007), 'The Book-to-Price Effect in Stock Returns: Accounting-Based Leverage and Asset Risk', Journal of Accounting Research 45(1), 149-190 (decomposition of B/M into an accounting-leverage/claim-shape component distinct from growth options).

Campbell, J.Y., Hilscher, J., Szilagyi, J. (2008), 'In Search of Distress Risk', Journal of Finance 63(6), 2893-2939 (book-to-market as a failure characteristic; failure realizations censorable in survivor panels).

Kothari, S.P., Shanken, J., Sloan, R.G. (1995), 'Another Look at the Cross-Section of Expected Stock Returns', Journal of Finance 50(1), 185-224 (book-based value measurement and its sampling sensitivities).

Merton, R.C. (1974), 'On the Pricing of Corporate Debt: The Risk Structure of Interest Rates', Journal of Finance 29(2), 449-470 (equity as a residual claim on the asset base - the claim-shape reading of book-vs-market).

Shumway, T. (2001), 'Forecasting Bankruptcy More Accurately: A Simple Hazard Model', Journal of Business 74(1), 101-124 (book equity as a hazard input; cited for the sampling argument, NOT used - no hazard composite is built in this lane).

universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.universe_eligibility_per_decision: member of the bookable pool AND >= 63 price bars through the decision date (inherited 63-bar floor, P3 dead_name_book_semantics verbatim: 'a name is eligible at a decision only with >=63 bars through it (inherited floor) and a non-UNTRADABLE band') AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; band D = UNTRADABLE_AT_DECISION, excluded, L-I3 fail-closed band resolution) AND RAW close >= 1.00 USD at the decision AND both cited clock fields populated as-of the decision (avail < gate(t)).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.sector_conditioning_choice: frozen empirical SIC-to-SPDR majority map shipped in cohort_v9.json (sic_sector_map, 157 SIC4 entries, sic_sector_ambiguous empty); every bookable leg carries its sector tag from the cohort build; a sector with < 6 eligible ranked names abstains that decision (inherited); a name with no map entry (none expected) abstains and is reported.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.warmup_rationale: level-ratio anchor with no delta legs - no YoY seeding is needed (V8 F2 precedent: ratio-level arms used warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start already seeds ADV63 for band assignment.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.decision_grid: trading sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0,1,2,...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring (inherited default 21-session grid); approximately 22/26/27 scored decisions in S0_FOLD_1/2/3 (exact counts fixed by the session grid before scoring).
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.holding_period: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank-hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile, effective holding 1-2 quarters; book forced flat at every fold boundary.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.entry_exit_fills_dead_name_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under avail < gate(t); fills at the next allowed session close (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill); fill_check verbatim from P3: 'a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing)'; exit_at_last_close verbatim from P3: 'a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation)'; forbidden verbatim from P3: 'no survivorship re-substitution: a dead name is never replaced by a successor entity's series'.
universe_warmup_clock_holding_fills.portfolio_construction: sector-neutral long-short: within each sector tag having >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the top-S tercile and short the bottom-S tercile, equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; at least 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9.

anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.arms_note: exactly three arms, per binding rule; the control-identifiability pre-check below is declared and measurable BEFORE selection and blocks the proposal without any PnL.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.anchor: filed-stub percentile rank S = StockholdersEquity / EntityPublicFloat under the two cited unbounded funded clocks; long-high/short-low within sector.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.neighbour_mechanism: book-cushion depth: Liabilities / StockholdersEquity under the cited unbounded funded clocks, long-LOW (thick equity cushion)/short-high, same book machinery. Required to SUPPORT the family with the same-sign alpha: both arms measure equity-cushion depth - the anchor from the market side (book vs filed float), the neighbour purely from the liability side (book vs book). If the neighbour carries the opposite sign, the market-side and liability-side readings disagree and the claim-shape story is not supported.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.causal_placebo_control: par-stub placebo: CommonStockValue / EntityPublicFloat under the cited unbounded funded clocks, SAME denominator and SAME 'equity account over filed float' ratio form as the anchor, same direction convention (long-high/short-low). Par/stated value is a legal-construct residue with no going-concern content: if it reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x |alpha| (control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt gate), the information is the filed-float denominator axis, not the audited book stub, and the family is falsified per the P3 causal_control_rule.
anchor_neighbour_causal_negative_control.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs par-stub: both numerators are equity accounts over the identical denominator, but the par account is issuance-history-driven (par per share is a discretized legal constant, typically one of a few values, times shares) while audited book is dominated by accumulated earnings and paid-in surplus - the ranks are expected moderately correlated (declared ex-ante expectation rho 0.2-0.6, gate 0.70 below), and the placebo's discriminating power comes from the par account's insensitivity to the earnings/deficit history that carries the going-concern signal. The float-size confound is additionally covered by a declared pre-selection diagnostic (rank of EntityPublicFloat alone, expected rho 0.1-0.4 vs anchor). Correlation profiles declared ex ante, never argued post hoc.

pre_selection_control_identifiability_ch.purpose: the V8 a5 lesson: control identifiability must be measurable BEFORE selection - a control rank-identical or degenerate vs its anchor cannot identify anything and must block the proposal pre-selection, from data alone, with no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_control_identifiability_ch.rule: On every frozen decision date t of the declared grid (63+21k per fold over S0_FOLD_1/2/3), over the pre-check universe = bookable pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha256-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns - the check is computable from the PIT panel and price availability alone, never from PnL): (R1) RANK GATE - Spearman rho with midrank tie resolution between the anchor rank vector and the par-stub control rank vector must be <= 0.70 on >= 90% of measured dates AND pooled |mean rho| <= 0.70; (R2) NON-DEGENERACY GATE - the largest single midrank tie-group in the control rank vector must be <= 25% of the measured universe on >= 90% of measured dates (V8 a5_h1 precedent: an 80.8% zero-change tie placebo is a vacuous control); no-par names (CommonStockValue <= 0) rank at the bottom of the control by declared construction and count into the tie-group; (R3) COVERAGE GATE - the control rank is populated on >= 60% of the anchor's measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4) ANCHOR NON-DEGENERACY - the anchor rank vector satisfies R2 as well. Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection (recorded INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE / INELIGIBLE_VACUOUS_CONTROL, fail-closed, V4 + V8 a5 precedent); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_control_identifiability_ch.inputs: PIT panel (field vintages under the cited clocks, avail < gate(t)) + staged price bar availability (bar counts through t) ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns, no PnL - nothing scored exists at measurement time.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per P3 factor_and_benchmark), per fold and overall; require excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds and overall alpha > 0; raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor; the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.stage_a_gates_applied_with_no_relaxation: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; folds positive >= 2; populated-fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15; ETF positive share <= 0.35; fold positive share <= 0.5; anchor overall alpha > 0; control |alpha| ratio < 0.5; neighbour support required; margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2); reproduction ALL_MATCH from a detached tree.

base_and_stress_costs.model: inherited liquidity-band cost model per p3_invariants_freeze.json (V8 payload carried unchanged): per-fill cost by the executed name's ADV63 band as-of its own decision date, charged exactly once per fill on traded notional, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar; band A (ADV63 >= 50M) base 10 bps/side, stress 20; band B (10-50M) base 15, stress 30; band C (2-10M) base 25, stress 50; band D excluded at decision; a band-A fill has exactly V4/V5 arithmetic; L-I3 fail-closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError (no silent fallback).
base_and_stress_costs.expected_blend: the dead leg skews to lower dollar volume, so the blended base cost is expected to sit between the V8 blend (10-15 bps) and the band-C ceiling (25 bps); the arm reports fills, cost, and booked PnL split by band for base AND stress reruns; stress = the frozen 2x-band schedule (20/30/50 bps).
base_and_stress_costs.death_leg_note: exit-at-last-close carries the delisting-return leg through the price series itself; no synthetic penalty is added and none is needed for the cost model - costs remain linear in fills.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 75); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: value_book rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are eligible exclusions - the max contributor may be a dying name; that is a legitimate drop, not a special case).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-signal-leg: recompute the anchor rank with the float leg replaced by per-share book equity (StockholdersEquity / CommonStockSharesOutstanding, funded unbounded clock {'field': 'us-gaap:CommonStockSharesOutstanding', 'max_age_days': null, 'coverage': 0.9051, 'mapped': 1398}) - a filed-shares-only denominator; survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the premium exists only with the float denominator, the effect is a filed-float-specific artifact and the claim-shape reading is withdrawn.

margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.note: declared BEFORE any scored PnL exists, per P-2; these are anticipations, not thresholds - the binding thresholds are the inherited gate table and nothing here relaxes them.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.expectancy_gt_0.0: MOST LIKELY BINDING GATE. The premium must clear 10-25 bps/side on a quarterly book whose short leg is a crowded-exit side and whose long leg concentrates low-ADV names; the anticipated margin is small and positive if the channel is real, and the first remediation shock (cost stress) is expected to consume roughly half of it.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.position_pf_ge_1.1: second-most-likely binding; a filed-value channel with quarterly re-rating is expected to produce PF in the 1.05-1.25 band if real, so the margin is declared thin ex ante.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.folds_positive_ge_2_and_fold_positive_sh: S0_FOLD_1 (2018-2020) is the anticipated weak fold: the COVID terminal event realizes the short side of the high-S distribution (glamour names recovered fastest post-March-2020); declared risk is fold-1-negative / folds-2-3-positive, which still passes the >= 2 gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: expected to pass with margin for a per-sector net-zero book at gross <= 2.0; the tail risk is death clustering on the long leg inside one sector-week, which the 63-bar/band floors only partially cap.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.etf_positive_share_le_0.35: expected to pass by construction (per-sector net zero); a fail would mean the tercile legs leak sector tilt via unequal sector populations across legs, which the per-sector net-zero rule makes structurally unlikely.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: expected pass if and only if the going-concern book content (not the filed-float denominator) carries the spread; this is the family's specificity gate and the pre-selection R1-R4 gates exist precisely so this comparison is meaningful if reached.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.neighbour_support: expected support (same sign); a sign disagreement between market-side and liability-side cushion readings is declared as the support-failure interpretation, not a tuning opportunity.
margin_to_fail_expectations_ex_ante.margin_to_fail_reporting: at scoring, every gate reports its distance to the failure threshold; a survivor reporting knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% of MDD headroom) is treated as thin-margin class per P-2 regardless of pass count.

novelty_declaration.novelty_standard: measured decorrelation |rho| <= 0.20 pooled vs every forbidden ancestor rank (plan section 1, V8 D2 standard), measured before selection - never prose. Pre-selection-measurable checks are declared below and run from the PIT panel alone; price-input ancestors (momentum, semivariance-shape, participation) are measured at D2 with authorized data (V8 A7-N precedent) before any selection freeze.
novelty_declaration.A4_XSEC_ETF_RELATIVE_MOMENTUM: CLEAN - no price input anywhere in the anchor rank (both legs are filed vintage values); the only price-derived quantities are the 63-bar floor, ADV63 band eligibility and the price floor, all sanctioned eligibility/cost inputs, not signals. D2 gate: pooled |rho| vs 12-1 momentum rank <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.A5-SFV2-TREND-DEFENSIVE: CLEAN - no trend/SMA/vol-target/defensive rotation; sector-neutral long-short, no time-series price filter.
novelty_declaration.SFV3-A5-IDIO-SHOCK-REVERSAL: CLEAN - no idiosyncratic shock/crash/overshoot variable; no OHLCV proxy fabrication (P3 no_ohlcv_proxy_rule).
novelty_declaration.SFV3-A6-TOM-SETTLE: CLEAN - the 21-session grid is a fixed session-index schedule; no calendar-conditioned claim.
novelty_declaration.SFV4-A5-H1-PARTICIPATION-SHIFT: CLEAN - no fresh-vs-stale dollar-volume shock; ADV63 appears only in the frozen eligibility/band floor. D2 gate: pooled |rho| vs participation-shift anchor rank <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.SFV4-A4-H1-SEMIVARIANCE-SHAPE_and_vol_le: CLEAN - no variance/semivariance/vol-level quantity anywhere; this is not a Section 1.1 vol-level re-entry: the rank is filed-fundamentals-only, expected near-orthogonal to the V4 shape anchor and the vol-level control. D2 gate: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs both.
novelty_declaration.EQ_S2_A3_F1_PIT_RECON_FLOW: CLEAN - no order-flow or microstructure reconstruction; 'stub' is an accounting claim, not an order-book object.
novelty_declaration.A5-S2-F1-LENDING-CONSTRAINT-PREMIUM: CLEAN and non-confusable - no securities-lending, borrow, or short-interest data; the 'stub' here is the book-equity residual claim from SEC filings, not a lending-constraint proxy.
novelty_declaration.SFV8-F1-WC-ACCRUAL-FLOW_and_WC_stock_sha: CLEAN BY FIELD DISJOINTNESS - the anchor uses no AR/INV/AP/Assets field and no delta of any field; pre-selection diagnostic declared: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the WC stock-level shadow rank (AR+INV-AP)/Assets and vs the F1 accrual-flow rank, both computable from the PIT panel before selection; a measured failure makes this proposal ineligible at D2 (no argument).
novelty_declaration.SFV8-F2-DEP-RESERVE-COVERAGE_and_goodwil: CLEAN BY FIELD DISJOINTNESS - no AccumulatedDepreciation/PP&E/Goodwill field in any arm; pre-selection diagnostic declared: pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the dep-coverage rank and vs the Goodwill/Assets bloat rank, computed from the PIT panel before selection; measured failure = ineligible.
novelty_declaration.V8_a5_ineligible_proposals: CLEAN - no asset-growth mechanism (a5_h2's Assets 12m growth is not re-proposed), no AOCI placebo (its measured 0.80-0.94 control failure is the reason the R1-R4 pre-check design exists), no authorized-share placebo (its 80.8% tie degeneracy is the reason the R2 gate exists).
novelty_declaration.v9_lane_separation: not a distress-lane (A4) duplicate: no hazard composite, no failure-probability score, no death-event timing (A6) - a single filed-ratio cross-sectional shape conditioning; the death-inclusive cohort is the universe this cycle provides to every lane, not this proposal's mechanism.

implementation_estimate.runtime: single serial cell, well under the 120-minute hard timeout with the < 45-minute safe-stop rule; memory < 8 GB (heavy_cap 1 respected).
implementation_estimate.scoring_cells: 3 (anchor + neighbour + control; base and stress are reruns of booked cells, drop-one reruns as declared) - both A5 proposals together would consume exactly the 6-cell V9 budget; unused slots never reassigned.
implementation_estimate.risk_notes: the 63-bar floor plus band floor on 2018-2025 data keeps many 2018-2019-era dead names out of early fold decisions (their bars end before the fold window) - expected populated-universe shrinkage toward the last fold is reported per decision; par-stub control coverage depends on CommonStockValue population (mapped 1479) - the R3 coverage gate makes any shortfall a pre-selection block, not a scored surprise.
